work.title: Add calc.rng
work.result: Added rng(xs) = max(xs) - min(xs), ValueError on empty input, with unit tests in tests/test_calc.py. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests: 17 tests OK. Commit 6b266eb add rng.

work.title: Add calc.mode
work.result: Added mode(xs) to calc/__init__.py: most common value, smallest on ties, ValueError on empty input; dict-based counting so no new imports (append-only edit to reduce conflicts with concurrent workers). 7 tests in tests/test_calc.py (ModeTests): single most-common, tie->smallest, all-unique->smallest, single element, negatives/floats, iterator input, empty raises. Full suite: 14 tests, OK. Committed as 039662b 'add mode' using targeted 'git commit -- <paths>' so no other worker's uncommitted work was swept in this time.
